questions.scenario: It is your turn to host the Monday morning school assembly. What are you doing?

options.A: I am standing at the podium, cracking a quick relatable joke about the Monday morning sleepiness to wake everyone up.
options.B: I carefully wrote the entire script yesterday, ensuring the 'Thought for the Day' and news flow perfectly together.
options.C: I am doing a quick visual science experiment or a small trick on stage to completely shock the sleepy students.
options.D: I am standing near the mic stand, signaling the choir to get ready, and making sure the teachers are seated.

questions.scenario: You are sitting on the backbench during a very boring History class.

options.A: I whisper a hilarious, perfectly timed one-liner that makes my entire bench burst out laughing.
options.B: I silently observe the teacher's weird habits and write down a funny, exaggerated story in my rough notebook.
options.C: I practice my 'pen spinning' tricks or secretly make an eraser disappear to entertain the guy sitting next to me.
options.D: I keep a strict lookout for the principal in the corridor and manage the 'alert' signals for the rest of the class.

questions.scenario: Your family is on a 24-hour train journey (in a 3AC coach) surrounded by random uncle and aunties.

options.A: I strike up a loud conversation, mimic a funny accent, and become the center of entertainment for the whole compartment.
options.B: I quietly observe the quirky things the co-passengers are doing and mentally structure a hilarious stand-up bit about Indian trains.
options.C: I pull out a deck of playing cards and blow my younger cousins' minds with a flawless sleight-of-hand trick.
options.D: I organize all the heavy VIP suitcases perfectly under the lower berth and manage exactly who sleeps on which seat.

questions.scenario: It is time to organize the 12th standard Farewell Party. What is your main contribution?

options.A: I take the mic as the main host to playfully roast the seniors and mimic the strict teachers live on stage.
options.B: I am the brain behind the scenes, writing the witty, emotional 'titles' and poems given to each senior.
options.C: I design a dramatic, aesthetic stage entry using perfectly timed spotlights and smoke bombs to wow the crowd.
options.D: I collect the 500-rupee contribution from every junior, book the DJ, and ensure the caterer doesn't run out of paneer.

questions.scenario: You are observing your parents during the chaotic 'Diwali Safai' (cleaning).

options.A: I physically act out how my dad struggles with the tangled fairy lights, making my siblings laugh out loud.
options.B: I notice the exact repeating pattern of how my mom scolds everyone and turn it into a highly relatable, structured story.
options.C: I take a break to create a visually stunning, perfectly symmetrical Rangoli that almost looks like a 3D optical illusion.
options.D: I take charge of the schedule, deciding exactly when the pooja happens, when guests arrive, and when we burst crackers.

questions.scenario: A local street magician (madari) comes to your colony to perform for the kids.

options.A: I banter with the performer, actively volunteer to be part of the trick, and try to make the crowd laugh.
options.B: I stand quietly at the back, logically breaking down his movements to figure out exactly how he misdirected the audience.
options.C: I am completely fascinated by his colorful props, the fast hand movements, and the visual aesthetics of the show.
options.D: I observe how he gathered such a huge crowd, kept them hooked, and successfully convinced people to give him money.

questions.scenario: Your best friend is feeling extremely sad after failing a unit test.

options.A: I do a goofy physical impression of the strict PT teacher to instantly make them crack a smile.
options.B: I send them a perfectly timed, highly witty meme that I made mocking the absurd Indian education system.
options.C: I show them a cool Rubik's cube pattern or an origami trick to creatively distract their mind from the stress.
options.D: I take them to the school canteen, buy them a samosa, and plan a clear, step-by-step strategy to pass the next exam.

questions.scenario: You are participating in the Annual Society Talent Show.

options.A: I do a 5-minute interactive comedy set, playfully roasting the grumpy society secretary uncle in front of everyone.
options.B: I write a hilarious script for the society kids to perform, making sure the punchlines hit at the exact right time.
options.C: I perform a mind-reading act where I seemingly guess the exact playing card the Chief Guest is holding.
options.D: I handle the chaotic backstage, making sure the mic battery is fully charged and the background music plays on cue.

questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube or Instagram Reels. What catches your attention the most?

options.A: Clips of Zakir Khan or Bassi, focusing purely on their delivery, tone, and how they handle crowd work.
options.B: Video essays breaking down why a specific movie dialogue or internet joke is structurally brilliant.
options.C: Zach King style visual illusions, smooth video editing transitions, and fast card mastery shorts.
options.D: Behind-the-scenes vlogs showing the massive crowds, stage setups, and logistics of a big music concert.

questions.scenario: What is your ultimate goal when you are part of any live event or show?

options.A: Hearing the deafening sound of a live audience laughing, cheering, and clapping specifically for my performance.
options.B: Knowing that my written words and observations deeply connected with people's everyday lives.
options.C: Leaving the audience completely shocked and staring in disbelief, wondering 'How on earth did that just happen?!'
options.D: Seeing a sold-out auditorium, happy sponsors, and an event that starts and finishes perfectly on time without a glitch.

Standup_Comedian.title: Stand-up Comedian / Crowd Hype Artist
Standup_Comedian.primary_match_text: The Spotlight Stealer! You are highly energetic, quick on your feet, and naturally hilarious. You thrive on live audience reactions and love being the center of attention.
Standup_Comedian.day_in_the_life: Hitting local open mics every night, testing new jokes, interacting with the front row (crowd work), and traveling across cities to make auditoriums full of people roar with laughter.
Standup_Comedian.alternative_match_text: Radio Jockey (RJ), Live Event Anchor, Actor
Standup_Comedian.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> College Degree (Any Stream, BA/BMM preferred) -> The real training happens outside the classroom: Writing daily, performing at local open mics, and building a strong YouTube/Instagram presence.

Joke_Writer.title: Script & Joke Writer
Joke_Writer.primary_match_text: The Observational Genius! You might not always want the spotlight, but your brain is incredibly sharp. You see the hidden irony in everyday middle-class life and know exactly how to structure a punchline.
Joke_Writer.day_in_the_life: Sitting with a laptop in a cafe, observing people, and writing hilarious scripts. You work behind the scenes writing jokes for famous comedians, YouTube sketches, or Bollywood comedy movies.
Joke_Writer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Arts/Humanities preferred) -> BA in English Literature, Mass Media (BMM), or Creative Writing -> Build a strong portfolio by writing blogs, tweets, or scripts for college theatre societies.

Illusionist.title: Illusionist / Stage Magician
Illusionist.primary_match_text: The Master of Mystery! You are highly creative, visual, and detail-oriented. You love creating the 'wow' factor and leaving people absolutely stunned with your flawless execution.
Illusionist.day_in_the_life: Practicing complex hand movements for hours in front of a mirror, designing unique visual props, and performing mind-bending card tricks or large-scale stage illusions that defy logic.
Illusionist.alternative_match_text: Visual Effects (VFX) Artist, Set Designer, Professional Photographer
Illusionist.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> College Degree (Any Stream) -> This is a highly specialized skill. Learn through dedicated magic academies, online masterclasses, networking with other illusionists, and immense self-practice.

Event_Manager.title: Event Manager / Show Producer
Event_Manager.primary_match_text: The Show Boss! You are a natural leader with a sharp business brain. You love organizing chaos, managing money, and ensuring the final product is a massive, successful spectacle.
Event_Manager.day_in_the_life: Booking massive auditoriums, negotiating with sponsors to get funding, selling tickets, managing the backstage crew, and ensuring the star performer gets on stage exactly on time.
Event_Manager.alternative_match_text: PR Manager, Talent Agent, Concert Promoter
Event_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Commerce/Any Stream) -> BBA in Event Management, B.Com, or Bachelor of Mass Media (BMM) -> MBA in Media & Entertainment Management or extensive internship experience at an event management company.
